name: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
overview: A chronic metabolic disorder characterized by persistent hyperglycemia resulting from progressive insulin secretion defect on the background of insulin resistance.
pathophysiology: Combination of peripheral tissue insulin resistance in muscle, liver, and adipose tissue coupled with beta-cell secretory dysfunction and incretin deficiency.
diagnostic_tests: Random Plasma Glucose >= 200 mg/dL with classic symptoms
research_summary: Current clinical trials focus on dual SGLT2i and GLP-1 RA cardio-renal protection and early intensive glycemic therapy to preserve beta-cell mass.

pubmed_references.title: Management of Hyperglycemia in Type 2 Diabetes: ADA/EASD Consensus Report
SGLT2 Inhibitors and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Type 2 Diabetes

name: Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease (ASCVD)
overview: Progressive lipid-driven arterial disease resulting in plaque formation, luminal narrowing, endothelial dysfunction, and potential acute coronary syndromes.
symptoms: Pain radiating to arm or jaw
pathophysiology: Subendothelial retention of apolipoprotein B-containing lipoproteins inciting inflammatory foam cell transformation, necrotic core expansion, and fibrous cap thinning.
prevention: Aggressive LDL-C lowering with statin +/- ezetimibe/PCSK9i
research_summary: Recent trials highlight residual inflammatory risk reduction using low-dose colchicine and RNA-targeting siRNA therapies against Lp(a).

pubmed_references.title: 2019 ESC/EAS Guidelines for the management of dyslipidaemias
Efficacy and Safety of Low-Dose Colchicine in Patients with CAD (COLCOT)

name: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)
overview: Abnormalities of kidney structure or function persisting for >3 months, staged by glomerular filtration rate (GFR G1-G5) and albuminuria categories (A1-A3).
symptoms: Anorexia and nausea in late stages
pathophysiology: Loss of functional nephron mass inducing compensatory hyperfiltration, intraglomerular hypertension, podocyte detachment, and progressive tubulointerstitial fibrosis.
research_summary: Breakthrough cardio-renal outcome trials (DAPA-CKD, EMPA-KIDNEY, FIDELIO-DKD) have redefined renal preservation standards beyond glycemic control.

pubmed_references.title: Dapagliflozin in Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease (DAPA-CKD)
Empagliflozin in Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease (EMPA-KIDNEY)

name: Primary Hypertension
overview: Sustained systemic arterial blood pressure >= 130/80 mmHg (ACC/AHA) or >= 140/90 mmHg (ESC) without an identifiable secondary cause.
symptoms: Occipital morning headache in severe cases
pathophysiology: Multifactorial dysregulation of vascular resistance, renal sodium excretion, sympathetic nervous system hyperactivity, and the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone cascade.
prevention: DASH diet (rich in fruits, vegetables, low-fat dairy)
research_summary: SPRINT and STEP trials demonstrate significant cardiovascular mortality reduction with intensive systolic blood pressure targets (< 120-130 mmHg).

pubmed_references.title: A Randomized Trial of Intensive versus Standard Blood-Pressure Control (SPRINT)

name: Hashimoto Thyroiditis
overview: Autoimmune destruction of thyroid follicular cells leading to chronic lymphocytic thyroiditis and progressive primary hypothyroidism.
pathophysiology: T cell-mediated cytotoxicity and anti-thyroid peroxidase (TPO) and anti-thyroglobulin (Tg) autoantibodies causing follicular architecture destruction and Hurthle cell metaplasia.
diagnostic_tests: Free T4 (low in overt, normal in subclinical)
prevention: No known prevention; managed with lifelong weight-adjusted levothyroxine monotherapy with periodic TSH monitoring.
research_summary: Current investigations assess the immunomodulatory effects of selenium supplementation and combination T4/T3 therapy in patients with persistent symptoms.

pubmed_references.title: 2014 Guidelines for the Treatment of Hypothyroidism
